security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown backticks and command examples throughout SKILL.md. Most table rows and fence markers are false positives, but several examples intentionally run infsh or npx. No prompt injection or covert data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Limit allowed tools to the specific infsh app run and app sample subcommands needed, or require confirmation for broader use.
Warn users before sending prompts, source images, or files to inference.sh, Google services, or Google Search grounding.
Move npx skills add examples to optional documentation and require explicit user confirmation before running them.

content.value_statement: Image teams need fast drafts and edits without building a custom image pipeline. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to run Gemini image generation through inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Generates images from text prompts using the inference.sh Gemini image app.
Edits images from supplied image inputs, including JPEG, PNG, and WebP files.
Supports up to 14 image inputs for editing workflows.
Sets output count, aspect ratio, resolution, and image format options.
Can enable Google Search grounding for current visual prompts.
Provides CLI, sample workflow, and Python SDK usage examples.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Sends prompts and image inputs to external inference.sh and Google services.
Model availability, pricing, speed, and output quality depend on external providers.
Does not add custom content safety controls beyond provider and user policies.

use_cases.title: Concept Art Drafting
use_cases.description: Create quick visual directions from text prompts before starting detailed design work.

use_cases.title: Campaign Visual Exploration
use_cases.description: Generate multiple visual concepts for ads, social posts, and presentation materials.

use_cases.title: Product Image Editing
use_cases.description: Edit product photos with new backgrounds, lighting, or composition guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana-2 to create one square image of [subject]. Use [style], [lighting], and a simple background.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana-2 to edit [image path or URL]. Change [specific element], keep [elements to preserve], and return one refined image.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Variants for Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana-2 to create four [aspect ratio] concepts for [campaign or product]. Compare the strongest visual directions after generation.

prompt_templates.title: Ground a Current Visual
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana-2 with Google Search grounding to visualize [current topic]. Keep the result factual, neutral, and suitable for [audience].

output_examples.input: Create a photorealistic widescreen image of a compact electric bike near a city train station.
output_examples.output: A generated widescreen image is returned with a short model description and image metadata from inference.sh.

output_examples.input: Edit this product photo to add a neutral studio background and softer lighting.
output_examples.output: The skill submits the image edit request and returns the edited image output, plus provider metadata.

output_examples.input: Make four logo moodboard images for a modern coffee shop.
output: Four generated visual options are returned for review.
The response includes a brief description for each output when available.

best_practices: Use clear subjects, style terms, lighting details, and composition requirements in each prompt.
Review privacy and provider policies before uploading confidential images or unreleased product visuals.
Start with one low-resolution result before requesting multiple 4K variants.
anti_patterns: Uploading private images without approval from the data owner.
Requesting many high-resolution variants before checking one sample result.
Treating Google Search grounding as a replacement for source verification.

faq.question: Does this skill require an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow requires the inference.sh CLI and login before running image generation requests.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents image editing with input images, including JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.

faq.question: Does it send data to external services?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and image inputs are sent through inference.sh to the configured Gemini image app.

faq.question: Can it use current information?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents Google Search grounding for prompts that need current context.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential images?
faq.answer: Use caution. Only upload confidential images when policy allows external processing by inference.sh and Google services.
